en: Black‑and‑white image showing a winding dirt path through a dense coniferous forest. Tall, straight tree trunks line both sides of the path. Two women in long, early‑20th‑century style dresses stand on the path in the middle distance, accompanied by a light‑colored dog. The scene is calm and natural, with no visible buildings or urban elements. A faint white handwritten numerical mark appears at the bottom edge of the image, as if from an archival or postcard catalog number.
